criteria.criterion: Exactly-one source validation rejects every named invalid case before queue, worker, network, or workspace construction.
The process-owned copy is 0700/0600, stable for process lifetime, observes replacement only after restart, and cleanup never alters the deployment source.
Concurrent and timed-out jobs prove context-local signer/principal/push isolation, one immutable startup signer, existing signature verification, and no workspace push remote.

Both out-of-`opcert_service/` signing producer chains — completion (`_opcert_signing.py`, `signing.sign_manifest`+`_sign_manifest_under_lock`, `transition_close.py:sign_completion_verdict`) and plan-review (`generation.py:sign_manifest`, `attest.py`) — sign from the injected context-local binding when the service supplies one (to BOTH job kinds), and the developer-local close/review-plan paths retain prior env/genesis resolution unchanged (regression pinned).

The op-cert application runtime (`src/rebar/opcert_service` process/container) has no SSM/boto3/region/key-parameter dependency: the compose service carries no `REBAR_OPCERT_SSM_KEY_PARAM`/key-retrieval region, the image needs no runtime boto3, and the key is materialized before start by `fetch-secrets.sh` to a 0600 file bind-mounted `:ro` with `REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH`. The shared `/rebar/prod/*` instance-role SSM grant in `iam.tf` is deliberately UNCHANGED (co-used by origin-guard/gerrit, not an app-role).
Secret/key sentinels are absent from repr, serialization, argv, logs, exceptions, output, fingerprints, provenance, children, and persisted envelopes beyond the existing public signature.
